Niterra.why: Through its group company NTK CERAMIC it makes ceramic packages (LCC, butterfly types) for laser diodes and optical devices used in optical communications; demand for laser packages rises with optical-module volumes.
Niterra.evidence: NTK CERAMIC product page (a member of the Niterra Group): ceramic packages for LEDs and LDs used in fields including optical communications; 'We support a wide range of custom geometries, including LCC and butterfly types.'

players.product: Ceramic packages (LCC and butterfly types) for laser diodes and optical devices, incl. optical communications (NTK CERAMIC)

quarterly_data.quarter: Niterra product page: NTK CERAMIC LEDs, Laser Diodes (LD) and Optical Devices (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NTK CERAMIC CO., LTD., a member of the Niterra Group responsible for the design, manufacture and sale of ceramic substrates and semiconductor packages (headquarters in Niterra's Komaki Plant; 627 employees as of January 2026), supplies ceramic packages for LEDs and laser diodes used in fields including optical communications, citing airtightness, heat dissipation and dimensional stability; its LCC packages with copper heat sinks have replaced standard AlN solutions for LDs, it supports custom LCC and butterfly geometries, and it is developing hybrid ceramic-metal structures for high-power LEDs and LDs.
